No! But... teehee. You're already working
so, so hard for me, Trainer.

Ah... Y-You're right!
I'm so sorry for taking up so much time with this...

Trainer!
I've decided to go with the regular training shoes!

She probably feels the same way toward me, her Trainer.
—Still, things can't go on like this.
With that, Nishino Flower headed toward the register.

Looking at Nishino Flower's bright smile, I reaffirmed my vow.
I'll do everything I can to keep that smile from ever fading.
Huh?

I won't let your advice go to waste!
I'll give it my all again starting tomorrow!

What kind of misunderstanding did she mean? Without getting a
chance to ask, I watched Nishino Flower hurry away.
Yes! They're so kind... I'm so proud of my mom and dad!

Thank you for your hard work, Trainer!
Um, thank you so much for today as well...!

I had planned to pay her back for yesterday's lunch, but...
before I could even call out to her, she had already dashed off.
(For training purposes, ones with more resistance would be better, but...)

Um... I got the wrong idea entirely.
I am so, so sorry...!

There's a good girl. It's okay. Once you finish rehab,
you'll be able to train again. Just take it easy for now, okay?

Y-Yes! Um, are you doing some shopping too, Trainer...?
I came to buy some new training shoes!

Huh? But aren't you in the middle of shopping too, Trainer?
I'd hate to... um, take up your precious time...

I gave her some brief advice, suggesting it would be better
to adapt as needed based on the situation, and then—

Today's training wrapped up before noon.
Just as I was thinking about taking it easy for the rest of the day—

I'll make sure to work extra hard too,
so I don't fall behind all your hard work, Trainer!
Th-That startled me...

I don't mind carrying whatever burden she has. If she's troubled,
I want her to open up without hesitation. After all, I'm her Trainer.
...Yes.

Even though your second growth spurt has started, your body is still developing.
If you overdo it, the toll will show right away. ...You understand, don't you?
Huh?! Ah, yes!

I'll be more careful from now on...!
So, um... please take good care of me tomorrow too!

But... whenever I shop for myself, I always end up hesitating.
I need to spend money wisely, so I have to choose carefully.

...Really? Then... um, okay!
I promise I won't take up too much of your time!

No, it's just that you were kind enough to come with me,
and here I am, worrying all by myself...

Of course! We'll support you with everything we've got!
First, shoes! We have to get you the best pair! And after that...

...They've been like that since before I entered Tracen Academy.
Always doing so much to support my training...

Once I get back, I'll get them ready so I can wear them tomorrow!
And I'll make sure to use my usual horseshoes, too—

Dad and Mom told me it was time to buy a new pair,
so they sent me a bit more allowance than usual...

It wasn't anything groundbreaking, just some simple advice,
but perhaps she took it too seriously.

...It's definitely not my imagination that something feels off.
It seems like she's going out of her way not to make me worry.

(I can't let that happen again. It'd worry Mom and Dad,
and cause so much trouble for Trainer too...!)

There's no need to put extra strain on herself all the time during training.
There are plenty of other methods, like using heavier horseshoes.
It's already noon... isn't it?

Let's find a place to train! Somewhere she can run to her heart's content!
Why not just buy a huge plot of land and build all the facilities...?!
(If something like that happens again...)

Nishino Flower is deeply considerate. She constantly thinks about
those around her, taking care not to become a bother or a burden.

They prepared so many things I needed for running.
Almost so much that I wondered if it was okay to receive it all...

—For the time being, you'll need to focus on rehabilitation.
I'll call a car, so let's head to the hospital just to be safe.

...Mom, Dad!
I... I want to run more! I want to run in lots of races!
Trainer? Um, excuse me...?

It's already evening, isn't it?
...I'm sorry for making you stay with me all day.

Hrmmm... Rather than regular training shoes,
ones that add more resistance might be better... but...

—That afternoon. While walking near the station,
I ran into Nishino Flower, who was out shopping.
